THIS WRIT APPEAL IS FILED UNDER SECTIOIN 4 OF THE KARNATAKA HIGH COURTS ACT, PRAYING TO SET ASIDE THE ORDER PASSED IN WRIT PETITION NO.102401/2013 (GM-RES) DATED 28.01.2014 BY QUASHING THE ANNEXURE- B ALLOWING THE WRIT PETITION AND ETC.

THIS WRIT APPEAL IS COMING ON FOR ORDERS THIS DAY, N.ANANDA J. DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:-
 JUDGMENT
The appellant is manufacturing ice blocks and also selling chilled water, however not according to ISI specifications.
Therefore, the concerned authorities, namely respondents herein had directed the appellant to stop activity of selling chilled water.
The appellant does not have bottling unit.
The appellant had not confirmed to specifications prescribed by the Bureau of Indian Standard Institutions.

2. The learned Single Judge having regard to nature of activity and failure of petitioner to take safeguards before selling chilled water, has declined to interfere with the impugned order passed by concerned authorities.
3. The appellant can not sell chilled water contrary to the provisions of Food Safety and Standards Act.
The appellant cannot have any grievance against the impugned order.
The appeal is accordingly dismissed.
